tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Ruijie RG-EW7200BE PRO – Advanced Wi-Fi 7 Router with Ultra-High-Speed Connectivity for Bangladesh

The RG-EW7200BE PRO is a next-generation Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) router designed to deliver unprecedented wireless performance for homes and businesses in Bangladesh. With breakthrough speeds up to 30 Gbps, this router transforms your internet experience by supporting multiple ultra-high-definition streams, low-latency gaming, and a large number of connected devices simultaneously.


Cutting-Edge Technology & Features:

  • Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) Standard: The latest Wi-Fi generation offering enhanced data rates, improved spectrum efficiency, and better reliability compared to Wi-Fi 6.
  • Maximum Data Rate: Up to 30 Gbps aggregate speed leveraging wider channels up to 320 MHz.
  • Multi-Link Operation (MLO): Simultaneously uses multiple frequency bands (2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz) to boost throughput and minimize interference.
  • 4096-QAM Modulation: Increases data density, providing faster speeds and improved signal quality.
  • Enhanced OFDMA & MU-MIMO: Efficiently manages bandwidth to support dozens of devices streaming and gaming without lag or buffering.
  • Target Wake Time (TWT): Improves power efficiency for connected IoT devices by scheduling transmission times.
  • Low Latency: Perfect for competitive online gaming and real-time video conferencing.
  • Support for 6 GHz Band: Offers additional channels for less interference and higher speeds, ideal for dense urban areas in Bangladesh.
  • Advanced Security: WPA3 encryption protects your network with the latest security protocols.
  • Backward Compatibility: Supports Wi-Fi 6, Wi-Fi 5, and earlier standards to connect all your devices seamlessly.
  • Multiple Gigabit Ethernet Ports: For high-speed wired connections and stable backups.

Technical Specifications:

  • Wi-Fi Standard: IEEE 802.11be (Wi-Fi 7)
  • Max Wireless Speed: Up to 30 Gbps
  • Frequency Bands: Tri-Band (2.4 GHz / 5 GHz / 6 GHz)
  • Channel Bandwidth: Up to 320 MHz
  • Modulation Scheme: 4096-QAM
  • MU-MIMO: Yes, up to 16 streams
  • OFDMA: Supported
  • Multi-Link Operation: Supported
  • SecurityL: WPA3
  • Ethernet Ports: Multiple Gigabit LAN ports
  • Power Consumption: Energy-efficient design
  • Compatibility: Backward compatible with Wi-Fi 6/5/4 devices
  • Smart Features: QoS, parental controls, guest network
